significance: A rock-cut relief panel at Mahabalipuram carved in the mid-7th century under the Pallavas, showing Krishna raising Govardhana amid scenes of cowherd village life. A pillared mandapa was built in front of it in the 16th century under the Vijayanagara empire.
story: The relief depicts Krishna lifting the Govardhana hill on one finger to shelter the cowherds from the deluge sent by Indra.
